subject: world_language
concept: Understanding a short past-tense story or dialogue read or spoken in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR A2 'understand short simple narratives' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student follows along with pictures while hearing/reading a short target-language past-tense story
exercise.abstract: Student answers simple comprehension questions about the story's sequence of events

misconception_flags: misidentifies the order of events in the past-tense narrative

interest_binding: story content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
